687
Shanghai Municipal Council.
November 2nd 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
FILED
Sir,
The body of the late General Huang Hsing was encoffined at his residence on 1st inst.
All prominent rebels and a large number of Japanese attended. It is already proposed to hold a large memorial service in honour of the deceased at some future date.
About 50 of the minor rebel leaders held a meeting at an Industrial Institute for the Poor Frenchtown at 3 p.m. on 1st inst. It was decided to address a letter to the Chamber of Commerce demanding $20.00 each for natives of Yunnan and $10 each for Hupeh men besides a passage ticket to their homes.
One of the rebel leaders named Kau Yih Fee 高一飛 is reported to be searching for suitable quarters in the vicinity of Pingchao Road in which he will establish a new Society for the promotion of the welfare of rebels.
The Police in the City and suburbs were paid on the 1st inst.
One hundred automatic pistols and 5,000 rounds of ammunition were sent from the Arsenal to Loongwha on the 1st inst.
Your Obedient Servant,
huuanduwstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
687
上海工部局。
1916年11月2日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
已归档

先生：

黄兴将军的遗体已于本月1日在其寓所入殓。
众多著名反叛分子及大量日本人出席了仪式。目前已有提议，拟于日后举行大型追悼会以纪念死者。

本月1日下午3时，约50名次要反叛头目在法租界贫民工业学院举行会议。会议决定致函总商会，要求除提供返乡车船票外，另向云南籍人士每人发放20美元，向湖北籍人士每人发放10美元。

据悉，一名名为高一飛（Kau Yih Fee）的反叛头目正在平潮路附近寻找合适房舍，拟在此建立一个新的社团，以促进反叛分子的福利。

本市及郊区警员薪饷已于本月1日发放。

兵工厂已于本月1日向龙华运送了一百支自动手枪及五千发子弹。

您顺从的仆人，
huuanduwstrong
总探长。
警务处总监。
